title: Incident Runbook
description: Schema for incident runbook structured data. Produced by incident-runbook-skill. One runbook per critical failure scenario. Required before first go-live and updated when MTTR > 1 hour.

scenario_name.description: Name of the incident scenario this runbook covers.

severity.description: Default incident severity for this scenario.

description_enum.P1: Service completely down — all users affected
description_enum.P2: Major feature unavailable — significant user impact
description_enum.P3: Minor feature unavailable — limited user impact

last_updated.description: Date this runbook was last reviewed or updated.

symptoms.description: Observable indicators that suggest this runbook applies. Must be specific and measurable.

where_to_observe.description: Where to see this symptom (e.g., 'Vercel function logs', 'Uptime monitor alert', 'User reports').

initial_triage_steps.description: First 5–7 steps to assess and confirm the incident scenario.

action.description: The specific triage action to perform.

expected_finding.description: What to look for and what it means.

tool_or_location.description: Where to perform this action (Vercel dashboard, logs, terminal, etc.).

resolution_steps.description: Ordered steps to restore service. Must be actionable and specific.

verification.description: How to verify this step succeeded.

escalation_if_fails.description: What to do if this step does not resolve the issue.

escalation_path.description: Escalation steps if resolution steps fail.

escalation_level.description: Escalation level (1 = first escalation, 2 = second, etc.).

trigger.description: Condition that triggers this escalation level.

contact.description: Who to contact (role, not personal name).

channel.description: How to reach them (placeholder — fill in during instantiation).

postmortem_trigger_conditions.description: Conditions that require a blameless postmortem after this incident.
examples: This incident occurred for the 2nd time in 30 days

prevention.description: Preventive measures to reduce the likelihood of this incident recurring.

code_improvements.description: Code changes that prevent recurrence (for responsible Dev agent).

monitoring_improvements.description: Observability changes that improve early detection.

estimated_mttr_minutes.description: Estimated MTTR for this scenario if runbook is followed.
